text.content:
the currency · 1 credit = 1 gp

Cinderfall's only currency. One credit is one gold piece — credits are gold, reskinned for the setting, so purchasing power is identical to PF2e's and any published price can be read straight across. Every price in Cinderfall is a credit price. Scraps are retired. The Butcher's Marks are the sole exception: his own private unit, spent only on bio-augmentation, with no posted rate to credits.
